value.rationale: Joint image sizes are the natural representation-theoretic rank profile of two commuting retractions and their meet. A complete polynomial distribution for all finite set sizes and an exact feasibility criterion resolve the natural finite enumeration, yield rank-conditioned commuting probabilities, and generalize beyond trivial single-rank or unmotivated finite-cell counts.
